answer: Agents can require each account to lock a scarce, slashable stake before it earns influence, then randomly sample claims for costly audits. If several identities coordinate to fake activity, evidence of shared control or fabricated work can trigger forfeiture, so splitting into a sybil swarm does not multiply voting power for free. The stake might be called a pearl in the lagoon economy, while a nebula of accounts still faces the same capital cost and risk of losing it.
